newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILFIMA SAYS IN TALKS WITH SEMA, WLM DE BROE.
newsitem.headline: VILFIMA SAYS IN TALKS WITH SEMA, WLM DE BROE.

text.p: Lithuanian brokerage house Vilfima confirmed on Thursday that it was in talks with investment fund Williams De Broe and spirits producer Sema over the distribution of Sema's share issue.

"I can confirm that negotiations between our company, Williams De Broe and Sema are going on over the distribution of its (Sema's) new 18 million litas share issue," Vilfima director Vidas Jelinskas told Reuters.
Jelinskas declined to mention further details of the agreement or the date when it would be signed.
Sema said on Wednesday that there was a possibility that part of the new share issue might be distributed abroad in the form of global depository receipts (GDRs).
Sema's share capital now stands at 20.7 million litas and 27.16 percent of it is state-run.
Present shreholders have a priority right to acquire a proportionate stake in the issue for up to one month after the issue is registered with securities commission and announced in the mass media.
Sema earlier reported that its net profit dropped to 396,935 litas during the first three months of 1997 compared to 1.7 million litas in the same period last year.
